description: Hand-judged relevant KR Part 2 clauses for rule retrieval. Judged from the rule text, not from any system output. Relevance is per clause so corpora with different chunking (the 18-row excerpt, the full extraction) can be compared. Clause keys: '<chapter>-<clause>', '<chapter>-GUIDE-<clause>' for guidance, 'APP-<appendix>' for appendices.
